scope: Web Feedback metadata and strict-mode capability probe for verified Sudoku/RubyBridgeSandbox sources
behavior: Metadata uses the current page, first user role, URL, user agent and screen dimensions.
Nested nanoflows retain the invoking page and role context; popup roles come from their workspace.
Mutated record parameters are tracked even when an action return is ignored.
Zero screen dimensions reproduce the native integer setter failure: earlier string mutations remain, previous dimensions are preserved and the error is logged.
The strict-mode probe creates and discards a draft; this Web runtime reports false, including asynchronous creation failures.
limitations: Only the listed source hashes are certified.
Other metadata variants using viewport dimensions or different empty-value behavior remain unsupported.
React Native, Mendix strict-mode clients, screenshot capture and annotation widgets are not included.
